newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's AIDC sees further profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's AIDC sees further profit growth.

text.p: Australian government-owned investment company, AIDC Ltd said on Thursday it was now well placed to improve its profitability after reporting a large increase in net profit for the year to June 30, 1996.

"While the markets in which AIDC operate are intensively competitive, the company is well-positioned to grow. We have commenced the 1996/97 year with a very healthy pipeline deal which provides a strong foundation for this and future years profitability," AIDC managing director Chris Skilton said.
Earlier AIDC said its year net profit rose to A$45.4 million compared to A$28.8 million in the previous year.

Speaking to reporters at a media briefing Skilton said the company expected to grow its revenue by at least 50 percent in the next five years and its pre-tax earnings by 70 percent in the same period.
Skilton said the 1996 federal budget had confirmed the government's intent to privitise AIDC. The board and management of AIDC fully supported this decision, he said.

"Although no firm date for privatisation has been set, management is working with the government to identify all relevant issues and to ensure an outcome that is in the best interests of the company, its clients and staff," Skilton said.
AIDC planned to maximise the opportunities created by its privatisation if and when it occurred, Skilton said.
Skilton said AIDC's new initiatives included the planned start of a leasing operation in early 1997 which would specialise in vendor finance.
The company saw resource finance as a big growth area for AIDC in the next three to five years and planned to set up a small team to advise clients in this area in 1997, Skilton said.
Asia was also a focus for the group and AIDC was undertaking a detailed study of the opportunities in this area over the next six months, he said.

"The company will continue to build upon its network of contacts developed through Asian advisory mandates and leveraged off the recent successful establishment of the China Water Co Ltd," Skilton said.
He said AIDC planned to emerge as a recognised advisor, finance arranger and equity participant in Asia.
